After the death of its parent, this '''Flesh Raider baby''' was orphaned and left in the middle of a path. This baby would have died, had it not been for a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who came across it inside a backpack. The Padawan fed the baby some [[guid]] meat before bringing it to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Quilb]] at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to decide on how they might aid the baby.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This baby appears in the mission entitled "Flesh Eating Baby" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The mission is located on the planet Tython and is only accessible to Republic aligned players.
